name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang's fascination with motorsport began during his university days, poring over engineering textbooks by day and tinkering with go-karts by night. He quickly rose through the ranks, starting as a junior mechanic before demonstrating a knack for problem-solving and strategic thinking that propelled him into engineering roles. His experience spans various racing series, from Formula 4 to GT endurance racing, giving him a broad perspective on vehicle dynamics and team management.

Wei Liang believes in a data-driven approach, emphasizing the importance of rigorous testing and analysis to optimize performance. He is known for his calm demeanor even in high-pressure situations, a trait that allows him to effectively guide his team and make critical decisions under duress. He is now looking for a new challenge where he can apply his expertise and help a team reach its full potential.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed hair with a slight side part.
physical.description: He is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized workspace, with tools and equipment meticulously arranged.
